value.signature: fn dispatch_prefix < 'r > (reg : & 'r Registry , prefix : & [u8]) -> Result < Instrument < 'r > , EnvelopeError >

review.body: { let (envelope , _) = Envelope :: peek (prefix) . inspect_err (| _ | { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; }) ? ; let instrument = dispatch (reg , & envelope) ; if matches ! (instrument , Instrument :: Refused (_)) { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; } Ok (instrument) }
review.item_premise: The boundary preserves its input, return and refusal predicates. Explicit bounded contract outcomes precede return inference; capture still follows the configured level. This body inherits the public-interchange decision for accept::dispatch_prefix. The bounded records operation vocabulary is generated from the operation registry; started/completed metric handles cannot allocate unregistered series. Refusal events change only observation classification.
